study_name.notes: No canonical study identifier provided in paper

pmid.notes: Derived from paper DOI; PMID is 27126044 based on document metadata

target_condition.evidence_quote: monitored strain populations in fecal samples from a recent FMT study on metabolic syndrome patients
target_condition.notes: Primary cohort had metabolic syndrome; C. difficile mentioned as successful FMT application

control.notes: Study included allogenic FMT (case-equivalent) and autologous FMT (placebo), plus healthy controls from published studies, but individual sample-level case/control status not fully specified per sample

body_site.evidence_quote: monitored strain populations in fecal samples from a recent FMT study

country.evidence_quote: Department of Vascular Medicine, Academic Medical Center, 1105 AZ Amsterdam, Netherlands
country.notes: Inferred from affiliations of corresponding authors (Nieuwdorp at Amsterdam UMC); study location not explicitly stated in methods

antibiotics_exclusion_period.evidence_quote: subjects in this study had not used antibiotics or other medication for at least 3 months before treatment
antibiotics_exclusion_period.notes: Study required participants to be antibiotic-free for minimum 3 months prior to treatment

dna_extraction_kit.notes: DNA extraction method not specified in main text; noted to be in supplementary materials

ncbi_accession.evidence_quote: Study sequence data reported in this paper are deposited in the European Nucleotide Archive under accession number PRJEB12357

sequencing_platform.notes: Paper mentions shotgun metagenomic sequencing but does not specify sequencing platform/instrument in main text or Methods summary

age.notes: Participant ages not reported in main text; referred to supplementary materials

sex.notes: Sex/gender not reported in main text or provided supplementary section

location.evidence_quote: Department of Vascular Medicine, Academic Medical Center, 1105 AZ Amsterdam, Netherlands
location.notes: Inferred from study site affiliation; not explicitly stated in methods

subcohort.notes: Study mentions allogenic FMT (n=5), autologous/placebo FMT (n=5), and healthy controls (n=48), but no formal subcohort identifiers assigned

subject_id.notes: Individual subject IDs not provided in main text. Subjects referred to as FMT1-5, SELF1-5 (placebo), and healthy controls (CTRL1-5, HMP) in figures only

sample_id.notes: Individual sample identifiers not provided; 55 fecal samples sequenced total from FMT cohort; additional samples from healthy controls. Specific sample IDs available only in sequencing database (PRJEB12357)

curator.notes: Not applicable; this is an extraction task, not a curated dataset entry

days_from_first_collection.notes: Study collected samples at baseline and 4 timepoints post-FMT at 2, 4, 28, 84 days; field would require per-sample specification not provided per individual sample

probing_pocket_depth.notes: Not applicable; this is a microbiome study, not a periodontal study

probing_pocket_depth_value.notes: Not applicable; this is a microbiome study, not a periodontal study

antibiotics_current_use.evidence_quote: subjects in this study had not used antibiotics or other medication for at least 3 months before treatment, nor did they do so during treatment
antibiotics_current_use.notes: Applies to all FMT recipients (FMT1-5 and SELF1-5)

disease.evidence_quote: 55 fecal samples from a recent FMT study of metabolic syndrome patients
disease.notes: Applies to FMT recipients only (FMT1-5). SELF recipients are placebo equivalent control.

fmt_id.evidence_quote: The cohort of 10 subjects—half of whom received a single allogenic FMT
fmt_id.notes: FMT1-5 received allogenic FMT, SELF1-5 received autologous FMT (placebo equivalent)

fmt_role.evidence_quote: half of whom received a single allogenic FMT (from one of three lean donors unrelated to the recipients) and the other half, an autologous FMT
fmt_role.notes: FMT1-5 are recipients of allogenic FMT; SELF1-5 are recipients of autologous FMT (placebo); three donors provided material

treatment.evidence_quote: half of whom received a single allogenic FMT (from one of three lean donors unrelated to the recipients) and the other half, an autologous FMT
treatment.notes: FMT1-5 received allogenic FMT; SELF1-5 received autologous FMT (placebo equivalent)

biomarker_name.evidence_quote: we monitored strain populations in fecal samples from a recent FMT study on metabolic syndrome patients using single-nucleotide variants in metagenomes
biomarker_name.notes: Multiple biomarkers used to assess microbiota changes; SNVs are primary measurement for strain-level tracking

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: Donor-specific SNVs were most highly retained 2 days after FMT (69.3±21.8% of determinant positions)
biomarker_unit.notes: Units include percentages and proportions for various measurements

biomarker_value.evidence_quote: Donor-specific SNVs were most highly retained 2 days after FMT (69.3±21.8% of determinant positions across recipients) and were still present 3 months later (37.6±16.6%)
biomarker_value.notes: Multiple timepoint values reported; strain retention declined from day 2 to day 84 but remained elevated vs. controls

disease_response_os.notes: Study focused on microbiota composition changes, not clinical survival outcomes

disease_response_os_unit.notes: Not applicable; study does not report overall survival

ecog_performance_status.notes: ECOG performance status not measured in this microbiome study

feces_phenotype_value.evidence_quote: extensive coexistence of donor and recipient strains (in 50.7 ± 10.1% of shared species) in all other recipients, which persisted for at least 3 months
feces_phenotype_value.notes: Feces phenotypes assessed via metagenomic analysis of strain populations

tumor_size_measurement.notes: Not applicable; study does not involve tumor assessment

tumor_size_residual_measurement.notes: Not applicable; study focuses on microbiota composition in metabolic syndrome patients

value: Study design: 10 subjects total; 5 received allogeneic FMT from 3 lean donors; 5 received autologous FMT (placebo)
Subjects had no antibiotic use for ≥3 months before and during treatment
Samples collected: once before treatment, four times after treatment
Comparison cohort: 109 metagenomes from 48 healthy FMT-naïve individuals from Human Microbiome Project
42 prevalent species analyzed across 5 phyla for strain-level tracking
Determinant positions ranged from 66 to 161,800 (median 15,550) per species
uncurated_metadata.evidence_quote: cohort of 10 subjects—half of whom received a single allogenic FMT (from one of three lean donors) and the other half, an autologous FMT (i.e., a placebo equivalent)
uncurated_metadata.notes: Key study parameters and design elements not captured by other schema fields

host_species.evidence_quote: fecal samples from a recent FMT study of metabolic syndrome patients
host_species.notes: Implied by discussion of FMT in human patients with metabolic syndrome; no explicit species declaration in paper
